behaviors.statement: record seals every status it writes, and check and lanes refuse a hand-set status, a hand edit, a copied record and a hand-deleted record scheme
behaviors.rationale: The seal and the record problems are file-state facts a pytest node computes

behaviors.statement: the record keeps the tested tree and the commit when there was one, and check compares neither with HEAD, so an amend, a squash, a staged attach or an unreachable commit leaves the plan valid; the PIP shows the record
behaviors.rationale: Exit codes and the record on disk after each git rewrite are facts a pytest node checks

behaviors.statement: record --staged records the index tree, runs the tests on an index snapshot no ref keeps, and refuses unstaged item files and a --sha given with it
behaviors.rationale: The provenance, refs, worktrees and refusals are facts a pytest node checks

behaviors.statement: record never refuses because of a broken seal, records a COMPLETE item again, and counts a dependency done only with a valid record (a sealed one, or a legacy shape on a legacy plan)
behaviors.rationale: Exit codes and problem lines decide each case

behaviors.statement: freeze --refreeze tolerates a broken seal on a recorded item and names it for a re-record, and still refuses a status without a record
behaviors.rationale: The refreeze output and exit code are facts a pytest node checks

behaviors.statement: plan.py verify reruns the COMPLETE items' tests at HEAD or the index, reports every item, and writes nothing
behaviors.rationale: Output, exit code and the unchanged plan bytes are facts a pytest node checks

behaviors.statement: legacy record shapes pass only on a plan frozen without a record scheme, an item with a record is judged by its seal alone, and a refreeze seals the scheme once no legacy item remains; todo_sync P2 reads a sealed COMPLETE record
behaviors.rationale: The record problems on legacy and sealed plans are facts a pytest node computes

behaviors.statement: SKILL.md states what a record proves (a seal, tree provenance never compared with HEAD, verify for the work still being there, record --staged for staged lane work) and drops the commit-ancestry rule
behaviors.rationale: Phrases in SKILL.md are facts a pytest node reads

behaviors.statement: On a receipts plan, a change found during execution goes to the plan's DesignEvolution through evolution_api.add and is cited on the record; the frozen plan is not rewritten for it
behaviors.rationale: Whether the agent edits the plan, writes it through plan_api or routes the change to the catalog is a choice under pressure; the driver refuses only after the fact
